claim: In the matching retail DLL, FormAnimator.UpdateAnimation (0x06004E7E) is a parameterless 738-byte method that resolves the current target Player, returns immediately when isAnmPause is set, calls ProcessFoxSleep, consumes reqAnmInit by calling InitAnimation and clearing reqAnmInit, and returns when CurrentSkill or CurrentSkill.anmData[CurrentAnmIdx] is absent. It then controls form progression: when the display duration is exhausted at the final form it checks PlayerStatusData.anmLoop and either returns or resets currentFormIdx to -1; it sets isAnmSync=1; when FormDispDuration is zero it calls ProcessAnmLoop, scans forward for the next formDispList entry whose dispFrm is nonzero, loads GetCurrentFormDispInfo, computes FormDispDuration=dispFrm+FrameWait, applies the exact centerPos-derived PlPos offsets and direction sign rule, stores FormRev=flags, and calls PlayAnimationSE. Exact flag masks then control AnmHostPlayer reassignment (4), ApplyDamage plus target CalcDownTime (32), and EndPriAct plus ApplySuicideDamage plus host CalcDownTime (16). When Ring.inst is present it calls ShakeRing with info.ringVibration, a Boolean derived from Zone != 1, and plObj.PlPos; it then calls ControlCheerSE. Finally it decrements AnmStopTimer when nonzero, otherwise decrements FormDispDuration, and returns.
